title: The Rains — Zimbabwe (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona heritage rain seasons Zimbabwe
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When the rains come to Zimbabwe the whole country breathes again
The dust that was the road becomes the river in the rain
The cattle lift their heads and the children go outside
The rains are the signal that the whole dry season tried to hide

[Chorus]
The rains, the rains
Coming down on the kopjes and the msasa red remains
The rains, the rains
Washing all the dry season from the fields and all their pains
The rains know what the farm was waiting for before we knew
The rains come down in Zimbabwe and the whole world starts new

[Verse 2]
The smell of the first rain on the Zimbabwe red earth
Is a smell that the body holds from before birth
Petrichor is the scientific name for rain on dry ground
And every Zimbabwean knows that sound is the homecoming sound

[Bridge]
In Perth the rains come in winter and from the west
And they're gentle and they're welcome but they're not the same test
Of the soul as the first Zimbabwe rain that breaks the back
Of the dry season — nothing in Perth quite brings that back
Except the memory — and the memory is intact

[Outro]
The rains know the farm… the farm knows the rains…
The gardens still growing
